changes: Aligns release-announcement nonce reconciliation and receipt readback with the native Discord send policy for public or exact approved-private guild targets.
Keeps unapproved private channels, DMs, group DMs, and private threads fail-closed before history or send.
Preserves deterministic nonce replay and exact guild, channel, bot author, content hash, and single-message receipt checks.
Records the exact v2.3.4 source release in append-only history without guessing the future v2.3.5 merge SHA.
known_limitations: Native reconciliation requires permission to read the exact approved Discord target history.
A bounded scan that exceeds 10000 post-request messages fails closed for operator reconciliation.
notes.rollback_note: Rollback restores exact v2.3.4 at ab6e2235c3a566893f6d9ba63d654b1dd6c657e4; immutable delivery request and attempt artifacts remain audit evidence.
